name: Incidence Matrix Obfuscation
description: Replaces the facility/valve narrative with a purely algebraic matrix equation $MS = \mathbf{3}$, where $M$ is the unoriented incidence matrix of the graph. This heavily masks the independent component structure and graph bipartiteness, misdirecting models toward linear algebra, Gaussian elimination, or integer linear programming (ILP) approaches that will either fail to compile or exceed the time limit.
